unresolvedPublicationFindings.reason: The first clause offers a guess, not an established arrival time, and Oo can answer the explicit open-stalls question. 'Oo, nagbaligya na sila og isda sa alas tres.' is a coherent supporting reply: they were already selling as early as three. Neither the progressive cue nor the visible earlier dialogue rules this out. Five is the expected echo of the guess, but it is not uniquely correct under the actual UI. This re-review therefore does not carry forward the prior no-issue statement about this time blank.

changedCouplingChecks.result: The native hedged guess and both translations agree. Siguro is recognition-only here. The following past nagbaligya remains licensed by niabot and ganina. Captions correctly quote the unchanged opening rather than this later turn. The spoken dialogue is acceptable, but the hedge does not uniquely determine the time choice: see CEB-R01.

CEB-01 resolved. The first two chunks and both glosses were merged exactly. Four chunks remain and their single-space join still equals the unchanged learner reply. The previously valid alternate order is no longer constructible. Recall, pattern examples, speech tokens, trophy, distractors and sentence-level translations remain coherent.

CEB-02 resolved. The set is now apan/gikan/tungod/nga. Gikan cannot introduce this bare adjectival clause; apan is the single fitting choice. Comparative cue, dialogue and all translations remain correct.

The added ang gives the canonical fronted predicate 'Adobong manok ang akong gusto'. The coupled cloze literal is identical and the complete cloze reconstructs the new twelve-word reply. Existing translations retain the same meaning. Neither pattern example reproduces that reply, and no other dependent target field requires a change.

coverage.unchangedLessonAndFieldCoverage: The full replay proves all other fields equal the personally reviewed round-one sources. This re-review does not claim a second fresh reading of every unchanged lesson.
